sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Stability Ball Back Extensions are a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. Using a stability ball increases the range of motion and challenges core stability.

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.content:
- Strengthens glutes, hamstrings, and lower back
- Improves core stability and balance
- Enhances hip extension strength
- Promotes better posture
- Low-impact and accessible for most fitness levels

sections.heading: Muscles Worked
sections.content:
Primary: Glutes, Hamstrings, Lower Back
Secondary: Core, Erector Spinae

sections.heading: Execution
sections.content:
1. Lie face down on a stability ball with your feet on the ground and hands behind your head.
2. Squeeze your glutes and lift your upper body off the ball until your body forms a straight line.
3. Hold for a second and slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
4. Repeat for desired reps.
